review: Manual visual review of every native frame contact plus exact delta bounds. Observed semantics are separated from new-art implementation proposals.

BARRAC.WSA.observation: Only the small foreground rooftop HVAC fan changes. The large troop formation and architecture are static.

parts.proposal: Paint three complete blade-disc poses inside the new fan housing; select the native phase, preserving the static roof and troops.

CARRYALL.WSA.observation: The red ground marshal at lower right changes arm pose. The aircraft and gantries remain static.

parts.proposal: Create a clean ground plate plus two new complete red marshal poses at the original body pivot; phase from the native two-frame sequence.

GOLD-BB.WSA.observation: A white vent/steam plume projects from the lower-right side of the missile, grows and disperses. The missile and dish are static.

parts.proposal: Create new softly edged white vent/plume phases over the painted sky/launcher clean plate, including the absent phase and authored idle holds.

HARVEST.WSA.observation: Small dust/spice puffs appear at the two lower tread-contact areas. The main vehicle silhouette stays fixed.

parts.proposal: Paint new contact dust/spice puffs at the original left tread footprint; preserve native empty/growth/dissipation phases.
Paint corresponding right contact dust puffs. Do not translate or bob the whole harvester.

HEADQRTS.WSA.observation: The single white dish on the far-right roof rotates between oblique and face-on poses. The left roof array stays fixed.

parts.proposal: Paint three complete coherent dish poses anchored to the unchanged roof mount; retain the authored hold/reversal sequence.

HITCFTRY.WSA.observation: Only two pixels in the small central status indicator change. No factory/aircraft motion is present.

parts.proposal: Use newly painted lens/emissive accents with two native on/off colour phases. Keep all factory geometry fixed.

HVYFTRY.WSA.observation: Two orange/yellow factory-bay glow/flame regions flicker; the large tank bodies and factory structure are fixed.

parts.proposal: Create new four-phase flame/glow art for the left bay, including its own local light spill.
Create matching new right-bay flame phases, retaining its observed phase relationship rather than moving tanks.

LITEFTRY.WSA.observation: Small left/right workshop welding or exhaust flashes change, plus a tiny suspended-crane/pulley detail. Vehicle and building silhouettes stay fixed.

parts.proposal: Create purpose-painted blue/orange welding/emissive flare phases.
Create new right-workstation welding/worker-tool flash phases, aligned to the painted station.
Provide a small new semantic pulley/tool accent with the native discrete phases.
limits: The exact tiny depicted physical part is not established by the indexed frames alone; no whole-crane or payload translation is observed.

PALACE.WSA.observation: Tiny guards/people change pose at the entrance/right foreground; a small lower-left status panel also changes. The palace, door and dome remain fixed.

parts.proposal: Paint complete tiny guard poses around a fixed native foot pivot.
Paint the native discrete standing/gesture phases, keeping the fixed body centre.
Create complete coherent gesture/walk poses and a clean plate under the original person.
Paint two tiny indicator accents driven by original discrete phases.

REFINERY.WSA.observation: Two ground-level horizontal yellow/gray marker or status strips pulse. The tanks, pipes and machinery remain fixed.

parts.proposal: Create a new smooth lamp/marker strip with the native four phase states.
Drive the separate painted strip by its original phase relationship.
limits: These are visible changing strips; whether the fiction is a signal or moving material is unresolved. No surrounding machinery translation is observed.

STARPORT.WSA.observation: After ten unchanged frames, a low transport with red roof lights enters from the right and travels left through a five-pixel-high strip. All tall towers/antennas are static.

parts.proposal: Paint one new complete low transport with red roof lamps and transparent alpha; use native-derived position/visibility per phase, clipping at the original scene edges. Preserve first ten idle frames and the exit.

STORAGE.WSA.observation: A small top beacon changes, while tiny highlights advance along the diagonal lower loading/ramp strip. The tanks and main loading platform are static.

parts.proposal: Use new painted beacon/lens states at native phases.
Use separately painted small material/highlight marks along a new diagonal ramp layer, driven by native phase locations.
limits: The tiny source changes do not uniquely establish whether these are conveyed objects or indicator highlights; do not invent a walking person or moving whole platform.

WINDTRAP.WSA.observation: The two large intake faces cycle through dark/blue flow bands; small fan details also change. Architecture and dunes remain fixed.

parts.proposal: Build new painted intake-face masks and smooth blue flow/emission bands with six native visual phases. Animate new face geometry/light layers; never recolour native per-pixel RGB onto the new painting.
Use a new small fan/rotor accent with the discrete native phases; preserve the background engine housing.
limits: Small rotor detail is difficult to distinguish from adjacent shaded intake pixels; match phase references before claiming exact rotor mechanics.

WOR.WSA.observation: A thin row of small light figures along the front base of the wall changes position/pose; the fortress itself stays fixed.

parts.proposal: Paint new tiny light-uniform patrol figures with a small pose cycle and native-measured phase positions. Keep their footline and authored eight phases.
